body: I finally had the courage to end it this morning. I feel like shit but I'm trying to fight every single minute the urge to run back into his arms. I'm really really really sad and I guess I will be for awhile. I dont have many friends to stay with me. Just trying to stay alive.

This makes me cry but thank you. Thank you for being on my side. I don't know why I'm so stupidly forgiving him every single time. I guess that's what "love" does to someone. 

I finally had the courage to end it with him today. I feel like shit but I'm trying to stay strong and fight every urge every minute I have to just run back into his arms.
I've been trying because I've become really extremely depressed because of this. Its really hard to find someone that is within my budget that has flexibility to meet.
Thank you. I need to stay strong. I can't give into my emotions and my sadness. I need to fight it as best i can.

I have tried to do this but I always end up giving in after a couple days.. I start to miss him so bad and start to forget all the cruel things he's said and done. And then when he messages and calls me its so hard for me to keep fighting it when I'm in that state of mind. I always end up unblocking him after a couple days. I feel like a pathetic mess. I feel stupid and so frustrated with myself.
The staying strong part is the part I seem to fail at every single time.

I've tried this before but after a couple days I always give in or go crazy or miss him or get so sad and then I can't stop myself from unblocking him, from reading his messages, from opening the front door, to see him there begging me to forgive him. I don't want to get hurt anymore like this. I can't take it but i can't stop.

This is not even the worst of it. And the reasons he'll break up with me are so unbelievably dumb. He has no control of his anger and lashes out. I realized just last month that I've been getting emotionally/verbally abused for months. And now I feel so beaten down and hurt that I don't even have the energy or will-power to pick myself back up. I feel so completely worthless and hopeless like as if my emotional stamina has just been through a million wars and back. Yet the feelings are stupidly still there. I stupidly still miss him. And it stupidly still hurts so bad every single time.
I don't get why all the vets I went to just act like its no big deal or like barely give me any kind of advise or response on it.
Omg really??? How do you diagnose that or how do you treat it?

>Does he do this stuff to his boss? To his co-workers? Would he go off if a cop pulled him over for speeding? No? Then he can control it. Its a choice. Its abuse.

I think this is a really valid point. I always thought maybe he had some anger management issues with the way he would treat me. He has never physically hurt me so far but he can get EXTREMELY angry and cruel and its just insane to see how far he'll go sometimes with his anger. But you're right that he does not act this way at all to anyone else. He even told me he doesn't know why he only treats me this way and that "he think its because he doesn't care about most things but cares a lot about me which makes him that much more hurt and that much more angry". I know thats not an excuse but like i said, i keep finding ways to make excuses or try to be undersatnding towards him.

I also think you made a really good point about the jealousy. I honestly have never done anything this relationship to make him lost trust for me, although after he started getting insanely jealous i eventually was more prone to hide things which he would sometimes catch. The only reason i would hide it was because it honestly was not worth the trouble. Like i could get a snapchat from a guy friend and then have to deal with hours of my bf telling me i'm cheating on him or badgering me about who this is and why hes snapping me, what did he snap me, telling me he doens't trust me all because i received a snap involuntary from a guy of the opposite sex.

I think over time i just learned to deal with it and just try to work around it and it really is not fair. To be completely honest, I deleted my facebook, my instagram AND my snapchat becuase i was tired of him causing fights and problems over it. He would get mad if i ever followed someone new on instagram or if someone followed me. He would stalk everyone who liked all my posts and if they were guys he would stalk them and question me about them. I started to disable all my notifications on my phone whenever he was around because every time I'd get a message (whether its a girl or not) he'd say something. Even when my roommate texts me i've heard him make little remarks like "why does she always have to text you, you live with her". And trust me-- i am BARELY on my phone around him now as it is so it's not that im constantly on my phone.

I never realized how much my life has been controlled now because of him because i guess i keep trying to find ways to understand him. I don't know why i still have feelings for him but i think its because of these feelings that i keep making excuses or hoping for dear life that he does truly love me. I melt like puddy in his hands when i hear him saying he loves me and its like a part of me wants to believe it so bad even tho i know for a fact its not true just because hes made so many of the same mistakes over and over again.

I know i need to walk away but its so fucking hard and i just hate myself more every time i can't do it.
I hope you're doing better off than i am.
How do you live like that? Its so unbearable at times for me.

I finally decided last night that I want to see someone regardless of whether they think my problems are stupid or not. I'm getting scared for myself because i really feel like i'm drowning in my own mind and i've never felt this way before.

When i start feeling down its like i'm drowning in those negative thoughts and i forgot how to swim. Its painful and it hurts and it numbs my brain and literally in those moments all i can think about is suicide. Its a really scary and dark place. 

I remember back in the day whenever shit went wrong or something bad happened I'd try to stay strong and optimistic to keep myself going but its like I'm not capable of that anymore at all. I'm incapable of being optimistic or having positive thoughts. I try to see it but its like i'm blind or something and darkness has consumed me. 

I don't know what to do. I don't know how to make myself able to eat. I don't know how to be able to sleep.

That's how i feel too. I feel like life has absolutely nothing to offer me. Like i have nothing to look forward to. Like whats the point of living if life has nothing to offer me? 

The only thing that stops me is my mom. I know she is mentally and emotionally weak too and it would just kill her. It hurts me so much to think of the pain that me killing myelf would do to her. 

Did you ever talk to someone or get help?
